_comment: Sponsors for Gitilla. Edit this file, commit, deploy -- nothing else to do.
They appear on ONE island only: the login named in "island" below. Every
other developer's city is untouched, whoever is looking at it. That is the
point -- the author sells space on his own island, not on other people's.
What is in here now is the empty inventory advertising itself: the cars and
the banner say the space is for sale. Replace an entry with a real sponsor
as it sells, and delete the rest when they all have. sponsors.example.json
shows the same file with sponsors in it.
cars:  each entry paints one car in the traffic with the name on its doors.
Order matters: the first entries get the boulevard, where the tour
and the drive-mode camera pass them. Six or so is the most that
reads as traffic rather than a motor show; eight is the cap.
plots: a hoarding on a plot out in the country, beside a road leaving
town, painted in the sponsor's own colour. One per road, six max.
plane: one big sponsor at a time. The prop plane that circles the city tows
their banner instead of the coffee one.
name:  what goes on the door / the banner. Short is better -- a long name is
shrunk to fit and stops being readable from the road.
color: the car's paintwork (hex). ink: the lettering on it.
url:   optional. Clicking the plane's banner opens it.
logo:  a file in this repo under public/sponsors/ -- vendored, not hotlinked,
so the page's CSP allows it and the canvas stays untainted.
